stem.text: Which compound is chiral and reacts with $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ to give $\text{CO}_2$?

A.alt: Condensed HO2CCH=CHCO2H, with both H atoms drawn on the same side of the C=C.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with CH3 and OH groups both on one ring carbon.

C.alt: Displayed formula: HCO2CH with CH2Br drawn above and CH3 drawn below the central carbon

D.alt: Displayed vertical chain: a carbon bearing Br and CO2H at the top, then CH2, then CH3 at the bottom
